exactFinding: 20 of 44 public pages (45%) omit the fundamental reassurance that the employer covers independent legal advice fees (£500–£1,500 + VAT) under Section 203(3) ERA 1996.
evidenceSource: Employment Rights Act 1996 s.203(3); ACAS Code of Practice 4; Conversion Copywriter Playbook
userImpact: Fear of solicitor legal costs (£300-£500/hr) is the #1 friction preventing stressed employees from proceeding to solicitor matching. Conversion drops by over 50% when fee reassurance is absent.
recommendedAction: Embed a persistent 'Employer Covers Legal Fees' trust badge and micro-copy across all calculator steps, guide footers, and hero banners.
evidenceRequired: Automated regex scan confirming 100% of public page routes include the fee reassurance token.

exactFinding: 64 brand compliance violations across the codebase: 37 em dashes (—) and 27 instances of the banned aggressive corporate term 'leverage' (e.g. 'counter-proposal leverage checklist', 'negotiation leverage').
evidenceSource: .claude/BRAND.md Brand Guidelines; Conversion Copywriter Playbook; data/audit/brand-copy-findings.json
userImpact: Aggressive words like 'leverage' alienate vulnerable employees facing termination or stress, while em dashes reduce mobile readability and fail brand linter audits.
recommendedAction: Replace all 37 em dashes with spaced hyphens (' - ') or separate sentences; replace all 27 instances of 'leverage' with empathetic, legally precise phrasing ('advantage', 'position', 'statutory standing').
evidenceRequired: Brand copy scanner (npm run audit:copy) passing with zero violations.

sourceLocation: Primary CTAs across 44 pages in data/audit/website-inventory.json
exactFinding: Severe CTA fragmentation with over 25 distinct button copy variations (e.g. 'Calculate my settlement now →', 'Calculate My Settlement Range →', 'Settlement Calculator', 'free settlement calculator', 'check your offer') with inconsistent casing and entities.
evidenceSource: Conversion Copywriter Playbook: High-Converting CTA Playbook; website-inventory.json
userImpact: Inconsistent calls to action confuse users, weaken brand recognition, and lower overall click-through conversion rates across the funnel.
recommendedAction: Standardize all 44 routes to the 5 canonical CTA variants defined in the Conversion Copywriter Playbook ('Calculate my estimate →', 'Check my offer now →', 'Get my free solicitor match →').
evidenceRequired: CTA uniformity audit verifying zero non-canonical CTA strings.

exactFinding: High drop-off rate between calculation completion and solicitor match intake due to lack of immediate local specialist availability preview and friction on /results/.
evidenceSource: Funnel architecture inspection; ResultsClient.tsx layout analysis
userImpact: Users receive their calculated estimate and exit the platform without submitting an inquiry, forfeiting commercial monetization for the platform.
recommendedAction: Add a dynamic 'Local SRA Specialist Available' module and prominent 'Claim Your Free Solicitor Match' button with zero-commitment microcopy on /results/.
evidenceRequired: A/B test specification and results showing increased click-through from results to match.

exactFinding: B2B solicitor partner acquisition is slowed by lack of self-serve onboarding, transparent pricing tiers (£150–£350 CPL vs monthly retainers), and automated SRA firm verification.
evidenceSource: app/for-solicitors/page.tsx; Partner portal review; B2B legal-tech benchmark models
userImpact: Prospective law firms cannot see transparent commercials or self-register, requiring slow manual BD outreach.
recommendedAction: Introduce a transparent B2B pricing table, instant SRA ID lookup, and self-serve onboarding flow for partner law firms.
evidenceRequired: Solicitor application completion rate metric and SRA lookup API integration.

exactFinding: Labeling Step 3 as 'Acas Typical Settlement' (SC-E-CLM-034) damages commercial credibility with partner solicitors who know ACAS does not provide settlement figures.
evidenceSource: ACAS statutory remit; ASA CAP Code Rule 3.1; Phase 07 audit register
userImpact: Solicitors receiving pre-flight dossiers with ACAS misattributions view the platform as amateurish, while employees form false expectations of ACAS endorsement.
recommendedAction: Rebrand Step 3 to 'Typical Negotiation Benchmark' and attribute data to MoJ tribunal statistics and industry settlement patterns.
evidenceRequired: ResultsClient.tsx text verification confirming zero ACAS calculation claims.

exactFinding: The solicitor pre-flight dossier lacks direct Practice Management System (PMS) 1-click export integrations (e.g. Clio, LEAP, PracticePanther).
evidenceSource: app/dossier/review/[id]/page.tsx code inspection; PMS integration standards
userImpact: Partner solicitors must manually copy dossier details into their case management system, increasing intake friction.
recommendedAction: Provide JSON and CSV matter import payloads formatted for Clio and LEAP PMS intake APIs.
evidenceRequired: PMS export button and valid JSON payload generator in dossier view.

exactFinding: Homepage hero section originally lacked prominent trust signals; however, unverified aggregate counters (e.g. 'Over £4.2M in settlement offers evaluated') are prohibited under CAP Code Rule 3.7 without documentary proof, requiring factual statutory and regulatory verification instead.
evidenceSource: app/page.tsx; CAP Code Rule 3.1 & 3.7; Legal and regulatory trust standards for UK employment law services
userImpact: Stressed employees arriving on the homepage require immediate factual trust signals without being misled by unverified vanity metrics.
recommendedAction: Deploy above-the-fold factual statutory rate verification ('Updated for April 2026 UK statutory rates') and an SRA-regulated solicitor network badge, strictly rejecting unsubstantiated aggregate figures.
evidenceRequired: Visual regression check confirming verified statutory badges and zero unverified marketing assertions above the fold.
